europe_now.title: Russian Drone Strike Hits Kyiv
europe_now.summary: A Russian drone strike targeted a television channel building in Kyiv during an attack that resulted in five deaths. The incident highlights the ongoing security crisis and the direct impact on civilian and media infrastructure in Ukraine.

europe_now.title: German Police Arrest Power Grid Sabotage Suspect
europe_now.summary: German law enforcement arrested a suspect following a manhunt linked to a series of attacks on the country's power grid. The operation addresses critical infrastructure security concerns in Germany.

top_stories.title: European Trade Restrictions on Israeli Settlements
top_stories.summary: France, the United Kingdom, and Canada have implemented trade measures to ban imports from Israeli West Bank settlements. These actions increase broader international and European pressure regarding Middle East policy.

top_stories.title: Political Shifts and Security Challenges in Germany
top_stories.summary: Recent regional election results in Germany have generated significant debate within ruling coalitions and raised concerns among neighboring states regarding the rise of the far right. Authorities are also navigating heightened security risks involving critical infrastructure and intelligence evaluations.
